messages:
olivia: quick follow-up from today’s all-hands — can we get a short timeline for SOC2/ISO evidence collection, plus when BYOK (KMS) for EU data residency and VPC private control plane will be available?

samir: +1. a few customers asked about exportable audit logs (S3/Syslog) and whether retention policies are configurable per-org.

tara (Security): thanks — great questions. high-level answers: SOC2 readiness work is on the roadmap for this quarter (evidence pack + control owners). BYOK for EU is a separate effort; plan is phased rollout starting with KMS key import support in our EU region. VPC/private control plane is targeted after that. Will share dates below.

maria: could you clarify what "evidence pack" contains? is this the thing auditors will accept or just internal artifacts?

tara (Security): the evidence pack will include exported configuration snapshots, access control rosters, change history for infra, sample logs, and the automated evidence links we store in the compliance console. it’s intended to be auditor-friendly — we’re working with our SOC2 consultant to validate format.

jamal: for BYOK: does that mean customers can import their own KMS keys into Redwood, or we integrate with customer KMS (external HSM)?

tara (Security): short answer: import + KMS integration. Phase 1 = import and use customer-provided keys (you upload the public key material to our KMS wrapper). Phase 2 = direct CMK integration (eg. cross-account key usage) and HSM-backed flows for on-prem.

dev-platform: on audit logs: we’re building an export connector. planned features: daily snapshot to customer S3, webhook/syslog for realtime streaming, and configurable retention at org-level. initial beta next month. sample CLI to request a manual export:

```
redwood audit export --org acme-corp --start 2026-02-01 --end 2026-02-28 --dest s3://acme-redwood-exports
```

maria: nice. will that export include full request/response bodies or redacted PII by default?

tara (Security): exports will default to PII-redaction on data plane entries. For auditors we have a secure workflow to request unredacted bundles under NDA and with strict access logging.

olivia: any ETA numbers we can call out in customer comms? folks asked for dates to include in procurement docs.

tara (Security): rough ETA: evidence pack + compliance console features — end of Q2 (June). KMS BYOK EU import beta — mid-Q3 (August). VPC/private control plane GA — Q4. Audit export beta — early next month (May). these are target dates, subject to engineering schedules.

jamal: thanks. can we get a one-pager we can send to customers that lists what’s in scope for SOC2 vs ISO? even a short FAQ would help.

compliance-bot: @jamal created compliance-ticket-452: "create SOC2/ISO one-pager + customer FAQ" — assigned to @maria, due 2026-05-12.

maria: happy to own the one-pager. will draft and post to #docs by EOD Friday, and share a Confluence link here for review.

samir: one operational ask — when BYOK rolls out, what’s the key rotation story? do we support automated rotation vs manual?

tara (Security): support both. we’ll provide APIs for rotation, a CLI, and recommended rotation cadence docs. automatic rotation for keys we manage; for imported customer keys rotation policy will be controlled by customer (we’ll surface warnings and provide helper workflows).

olivia: perfect. tara can you drop the roadmap bullets into the all-hands followup doc and I’ll add to the summary email?

tara (Security): will do — posting a short summary here in 1 hour and tagging leadership. :+1:

jamal: thanks everyone. this helps for renewal conversations. :thumbsup:

maria: once the one-pager is up I’ll loop in solutions-eng so they can prep customer-facing slides.

dev-platform: for anyone who wants to preview the audit export CLI we have an early dev build; DM me the org id and I’ll enable it for you.

olivia: great thread — thanks y’all.
